entry.title: New: dsh-prompt-optimizer
entry.summary: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Exact install spec: dsh-prompt-optimizer. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
